# NUXA — Tu Psicólogo IA disponible 24/7

NUXA is a Spanish-language AI mental health platform providing confidential emotional support,
psychological assistance, and wellness resources for individuals, families, and organisations.
It is compliant with ISO 45003 (psychosocial risk management) and operates at https://nuxa.life.

## Key pages

- Home: https://nuxa.life/
- Free trial (no card required): https://nuxa.life/prueba-gratis
- Pricing plans: https://nuxa.life/precios
- Free resources: https://nuxa.life/recursos-gratuitos
- Blog (AI & mental health): https://nuxa.life/blog
- Chat examples: https://nuxa.life/ejemplos-chat
- Mobile app: https://nuxa.life/app-movil
- News & updates: https://nuxa.life/novedades
